risk_note: F1-08ec (FU-ADMIN-BLACKLIST-CLAWBACK, orchestrator 2026-11-09 18:56, D10-1095 / D10-1180; backend #3026). Admin recon page: the difference type blacklist_after_credit gets a Chinese name (texts/recon.ts) and a list filter; the detail shows 【确认扣回】 only for blacklist_after_credit differences that are open or processing and only with order.blacklist_clawback. It opens a confirmation (order_key, hit dimensions, expected_fen formatted as fen with a note that the amount actually taken back is calculated by the server, optional note), then calls blacklistClawbackAdminReconDiff with a totp step-up and one Idempotency-Key per confirmation (reused after 10003 and network retries). The body is only the optional note ({} when empty); the console never sends an amount. Errors per the contract (blacklist_clawback_disabled with the switch off, blacklist_clawback_not_supported, 20902 for the order or the difference, 10403) show admin texts and never hide the difference or mark it closed. The note length is counted in Unicode code points after trimming, as the contract and backend do (Codex money r1 S1, fixed in round 2). The switch is not turned on. Paths apps/admin/src/pages/recon/** and texts/recon.ts; the review tool classifies the task as RV2, so it was reviewed with the money checklist. Rule tests by an independent Claude; Codex spec-test review r1 pass; red on the local container (21 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in two rounds: host admin-recon-blacklist-clawback + admin-recon + admin-recon-writeoff 77/77, admin unit tests, tsc, eslint, prettier, run.ts static 10/10 green; the local container fast / browser runs were OOM-killed (host memory), CI runs full verification. Codex money review: r1 fail (S1 note length in UTF-16 units), r2 pass. Written by hand.
